assignments.node_id: כשיסתכל בדבר מה, תכף, יאמין באמונה שלמה שיש בדבר הזה אותיות וניצוצות
assignments.reason: This node describes the act of looking at any thing and immediately believing with complete faith (אמונה שלמה) that it contains letters and divine sparks. Its essential nature is faith — the foundational emunah that perceives hidden divine vitality in all created things. The Rebbe explicitly frames this as the eitza (advice) for elevating sparks, and the mechanism is faith itself. It shares the same essential domain as Package 1's core concept of אמונה.

Elevating sparks to God is the sacred purpose that faith serves in this Torah. Its essential nature is divine service rooted in faith — the Rebbe teaches that one can only elevate sparks through the faith described in Package 1. While the node describes a spiritual goal rather than faith itself, in Torah #94 spark-elevation is entirely dependent on and defined through emunah: the eitza for elevating sparks IS faith. With only one existing package available, and given that this node belongs squarely to the holy/good domain of the teaching, Package 1 is the correct assignment.
